name: LOOP THE LOOP Fandisc
original_name: LOOP THE LOOP ファンディスク
source:
A dedicated Fandisc for the LOOP THE LOOP series, featuring characters from the 1st Series.

The main content is a non-canon scenario named "Ship Party". It is a what-if story, where 23 characters, including those who are enemies or deceased in the main canon, gather for a grand banquet aboard a luxury liner called Gouka Kyakusen. The story focuses on comedic interactions and peaceful character dynamics that are impossible in the main storyline.

Also includes Character Profiles and Popularity Poll Short Stories.
